newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria offers 10 discount T-bill issues this wk.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria offers 10 discount T-bill issues this wk.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry will auction 10 issues of discount T-bills with no par value set in advance this week, the central bank said.
Half the issues have a one-week maturity and the rest have a four-week maturity. Auction dates and issue dates for each issue overlap.
The ministry has issued short-term treasury bills each day since January 20 to regulate excessive banks' liquidity in line with preparations for the introduction of a restrictive monetary regime.
As a result of the ministry's decison, the central bank has suspended its daily open market operations through daily reverse repo auctions with repurchase of over two days.

The decisions were related to preparing the banking system for the introduction of a currency board system proposed by the International Monetary Fund under which central bank open market operations would be curbed.
